Next: Things to Do in Port Aransas ↓
Explore Port Aransas
Port Aransas has plenty beyond the beach and the golf cart. Here are some dining spots and activities worth putting on the week's agenda. Tap anything that interests you to keep track.
DINING
Virginia's on the Bay
Waterfront seafood with bay views — a Port Aransas institution · ~$20–35/pp
Trout Street Bar & Grill
Casual waterfront dining, great for big groups, cold drinks included · ~$15–25/pp
Shells Pasta & Seafood
Local favorite for pasta and fresh Gulf seafood — a solid dinner-out pick · ~$18–30/pp
The Gaff
Laid-back beach bar and grill, kids welcome, great for a casual night out · ~$10–20/pp
ACTIVITIES & ATTRACTIONS
Deep-Sea Fishing Charter
Half-day Gulf fishing — a Port A rite of passage for families · ~$80–120/pp
Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals
Explore the bays and coves at your own pace — great for the kids · ~$25–45/pp
Parasailing
Big Gulf views from above — the kids will remember this one for years · ~$70–90/pp
Roberts Point Park
Free waterfront park with a fishing pier, playground, and splash pad · Free
Mustang Island State Park
5 miles of undeveloped Gulf beach — perfect for shelling and birding · ~$5/person
